description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/custom-lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildCustomMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_BuildCustomMachine">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Builder" name="Builder">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Building</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DevelopDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_BuildTestSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MachineAssembled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Group of children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Start building the machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop the basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give the Lego sets to the children"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildTestSubcomponents" name="Build and test each subcomponent">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics/>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Subcomponent" name="Start a subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContainerParts" name="Parts remain in a container?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Continue building"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build the subcomponent from sorted parts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test the subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign the subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubcomponentSuccessful" name="Subcomponent test successful"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubcomponentStart_ContainerCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_Subcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_ContainerParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContainerParts_Remain" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContainerParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContainerParts_Empty" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContainerParts" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not partsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_BuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildMerge_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Success" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_SubcomponentSuccessful">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Failure" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Redesign_ContainerCheck" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_ContainerParts"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble the subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Design" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_OrderSets" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSets_GiveSets" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiveSets_SortParts" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SortParts_BuildTest" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildTestSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildTest_Assemble" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildTestSubcomponents" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_End" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
